moments.title: A human hair is approximately 70,000 nanometres in diameter; the most advanced commercial transistors are manufactured at a 2-nanometre process node - meaning roughly 35,000 transistors could be placed side by side acros
moments.selftext: A human hair is approximately 70,000 nanometres in diameter; the most advanced commercial transistors are manufactured at a 2-nanometre process node - meaning roughly 35,000 transistors could be placed side by side across the width of a single human hair. At this scale, transistors are made of structures just a few atoms wide, and quantum effects are no longer side effects - they are part of the design.
